ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 import * from dw::core::Strings output application/json var codes = keysOf(vars.connectionDetails default {}) map ($ as String) var refs = [payload.external_id, payload.prescription.surescripts_erx_id, payload.prescription.surescripts_erx_order_number] filter ((r) -> if (r is String) ((r contains ":") and (codes contains substringBefore(r, ":"))) else false) --- { code: if (isEmpty(refs)) "" else substringBefore(refs[0], ":"), ref: if (isEmpty(refs)) null else substringAfter(refs[0], ":"), source: if (isEmpty(refs)) null else "prefix", prescriptionId: payload.prescription_id default payload.prescription.id }

db:insert.doc:name: Insert Partner Prescription
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[%dw 2.0 output application/java --- { external_id: vars.routing.code ++ ":" ++ (vars.routing.ref default "") ++ "#" ++ (vars.routing.prescriptionId as String), provider_external_id: vars.routing.ref default "", provider: vars.connectionDetails[vars.routing.code].provider default vars.routing.code, provider_code: vars.routing.code, provider_id: vars.routing.code, drx_id: vars.routing.prescriptionId as String, drx_id_check: vars.routing.prescriptionId as String }]

logger.doc:name: Could Not Record
logger.message: #["Could not record partner prescription " ++ ((vars.routing.prescriptionId default "") as String) ++ ": " ++ (error.description default "")]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 import * from dw::core::Strings output application/json var row = vars.dbSearchResponse[0] var code = row.provider_code default "" // provider_external_id is the partner's own id; external_id is only the row key var ext = if (isEmpty(row.provider_external_id)) row.external_id else row.provider_external_id --- { code: code, ref: if (ext is String) (if (ext startsWith (code ++ ":")) substringAfter(ext, ":") else ext) else ext, source: if (isEmpty(code)) null else "db", prescriptionId: vars.routing.prescriptionId }
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- if (isEmpty(vars.routing.code)) null else vars.connectionDetails[vars.routing.code]

logger.doc:name: Log Provider Information
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "messages" : "Posting prescription-fill status to provider", "provider": vars.provider, "fill_id": vars.id, "status": payload.status }]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "status": "Ignored", "reason_code": if (isEmpty(vars.provider)) "NOT_A_PARTNER_ORDER" else if (vars.provider == "WLM") "STATUS_NOT_SENT_TO_PARTNER" else "NO_WEBHOOK_URL", "provider": if (isEmpty(vars.provider)) null else vars.provider, "id": vars.id }
